vectors.description: Delegation whose StatusList2021 bit is 0 (not revoked)
vectors.reason: An unset revocation bit means the credential is active
A set revocation bit must reject the credential

vectors.description: Revoked delegation checked against its list with the bit cleared after signing
vectors.reason: The list's proof no longer verifies, so its bits cannot be read and the check fails closed

vectors.description: Revoked delegation checked against a list with the bit unset, validly signed by another DID
vectors.reason: Another DID's list cannot speak for the credential, so it cannot clear the revocation and the check fails closed

vectors.description: Revoked delegation checked against its issuer's suspension list with the bit unset
vectors.reason: A list of another statusPurpose says nothing of revocation, so the check fails closed

vectors.description: Revoked delegation checked against its issuer's StatusList2021 list with the bit unset, stating its purposes as an array
vectors.reason: A StatusList2021 list states one statusPurpose, and only a Bitstring Status List v1.0 list may state several, so the check fails closed

vectors.description: Revoked delegation checked against its issuer's list for another URL, with the bit unset
vectors.reason: A list that states another URL as its id is not the list the credential names, so the check fails closed

vectors.description: Revoked delegation a delegate of the pinned root issued, checked against the root's list with the bit unset, re-issued without an id
vectors.reason: Only the credential's own issuer may leave out a list's id; the pinned root's list must state the URL it is read from, so the check fails closed

vectors.description: Revoked delegation checked against a list with the bit unset, signed by a DID the verifier accepts for its issuer and stating no id
vectors.reason: A list from an issuer other than the credential's must state the URL it is read from as its id, so the check fails closed

vectors.description: Active delegation checked against its issuer's list, re-issued without an id
vectors.reason: The credential's own issuer's list need not state an id, so it is read and the unset bit means the credential is active

vectors.description: Active delegation checked against its issuer's Bitstring Status List v1.0 list for suspension and revocation
vectors.reason: A BitstringStatusListCredential may declare several purposes; one that includes revocation is read, and the unset bit means the credential is active
